subtitle: Lesson 70 · Graph Algorithms & Data Science

caption: Structure, not any single row's attributes, is the signal.

code:
MATCH (c:Customer {name:'Priya Nair'})
  -[:SIMILAR_TO]->(similar:Customer)
MATCH (similar)-[:PURCHASED]->(rec:Product)
WHERE NOT (c)-[:PURCHASED]->(rec)
RETURN rec.name, count(*) AS strength
ORDER BY strength DESC
caption: Similarity precomputed offline; traversal is cheap at request time.
